info.name: NW Track - Manual API requests
info.description: Standard Postman requests in use-case folders. No pre-request or post-response scripts. Import this JSON using Import > Files, select the LAN environment, then double-click a request under Collections to open a normal request tab and click Send. Copy tokens and resource IDs from responses into environment variables manually. See README.md for instructions.
